## Recommendation (not promoted to constants)
- Do not anchor Phase 2/3 on full-width fr challenge decompose gates — they no longer exist.
- Prefer stage-boundary BlockSnapshot fingerprints (HonkBaselineAnalysis tags) and/or
  poseidon2_* FS hash windows for challenge-phase boundaries.
- Candidate G (Output recursion_separator short split) is unique but late; unsuitable as
  primitive_start. Candidate E (KZG batch-mul) is the strongest large-region fingerprint.
- Promote only after Phase 2 primitive_start discovery on the chosen chain.
